LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 15.3.1 TYPES OF SENTENCES: INTERROGATIVE SENTENCES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we use compound nouns when communicating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify compound nouns in a text
2. use compound nouns in their singular and plural forms
3. appreciate the importance of compound nouns in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 15.3.1 TYPES OF SENTENCES: INTERROGATIVE SENTENCES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify compound nouns in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use compound nouns in their singular and plural forms
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of compound nouns in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences with school or home examples.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

2. use compound nouns in their singular and plural forms
